name: Raffles Dubai
positioning: Egyptian-inspired city hotel with Asian style and private gardens, beside Wafi Mall in Dubai's business and shopping district
best_for: Travelers who want a city base close to Wafi Mall and the Khan Murjan souk
Guests who value round-the-clock butler service
Spa-goers and travelers interested in cultural experiences such as calligraphy

facts.text: The hotel is in Dubai's business and shopping district, adjacent to Wafi Mall and close to the Khan Murjan souk and the convention centres.
The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Dubai International Airport.
The hotel is surrounded by private gardens.
Rooms have balcony views over the city, with handcrafted decorative items and luxurious fabrics.
Suites have detailing infused with Middle Eastern and Asian design.
Spa treatments are inspired by Asian, Middle Eastern and European traditions.
The spa facilities include male and female areas, sauna and steam rooms, and a hair salon.
The outdoor pool has a heated Jacuzzi, water loungers and a kids pool.
Solo serves Italian menus inspired by regional recipes from Lombardy, Tuscany, Campania and Sicily.
Afternoon tea is served at Raffles Salon.
The hotel has meeting rooms, a library and the Raffles Ballroom.

highlights.text: The building is an architectural surprise inspired by an Egyptian aesthetic, paired with sophisticated Asian style.

The Calligraphy Workshop Stay is a workshop with local calligraphy artist Amir Golshani; the package includes an overnight stay in a Diplomatic Suite, a one-hour class in the Penthouse Suite and Treasures of Arabia afternoon tea.
A Day With The Chef starts with a personalised tour of the local fish and spice market.
The Butler Did It is a bespoke four-night, five-day journey built around Raffles butler service.
Raffles Spa has six spa suites, including one designed for couples.

considerations.text: This is a city-centre hotel in the business and shopping district next to Wafi Mall, not a beach resort.
The Calligraphy Workshop Stay requires two weeks' advance booking.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
